content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Stripe and PayPal offer streamlined solutions that provide users with a familiar interface and integrated payment processing. However, their services are tightly restricted, particularly in developing regions. For instance, Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also limit access based on geographical location, making them ineffective for creators in countries where these platforms are unavailable. On the flip side, sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators with full ownership of their sales architecture, enabling them to set up their stores on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages without reliance on third-party payment processors.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal's geographic restrictions create substantial hurdles for creators in many countries. For example, a PayPal account suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days without an appeal, effectively locking out users from their cash flow. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure transcends these barriers by using decentralized payment systems such as NOWPayments, allowing creators to utilize over 300 cryptocurrencies without geographical restrictions. This ensures creators can sell their digital products without worrying about account freezes or service denials.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

While Stripe and PayPal advertise quick payment processing, the reality is often different, particularly for users in restricted countries. Payment delays can occur due to compliance issues or cross-border transaction limitations. In addition, fees can accumulate unexpectedly, impacting overall revenue. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, offers minimal transaction fees through solutions like NOWPayments, charging only 0.5% per transaction with the added benefit of instant payment confirmation. This structure significantly reduces operational costs, allowing creators to retain more of their earnings.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures you own your entire sales process.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Using platforms like Stripe or PayPal means creators often relinquish some control over their sales data and payment processes. They depend on these services for delivery, risking account suspension that can disrupt business. On the contrary, sovereign commerce infrastructure guarantees full ownership and control, ensuring creators can manage their digital products and customer data autonomously. Automated delivery systems integrated within the stack enable seamless transactions and instant product access for buyers, eliminating reliance on third-party services.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture hinges on your specific needs and circumstances. If you're a creator in a restricted country, relying on platforms like Stripe or PayPal is a gamble. Instead, investing in a sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as the Complete Builder Kit ($197), provides you with all the blueprints and templates required to build and deploy your own online store. This gives you the freedom to operate without the limitations imposed by conventional platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Payment freezes and account suspensions are eliminated with decentralized payment solutions.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
